map.几何平均考虑复利，低于算术平均。: The geometric mean accounts for compounding and is lower than the arithmetic mean.

map.为什么低于算术平均？: Why is it lower than the arithmetic mean?
map.波动拖累复合：涨 20% 后跌 5% 不能抵消，几何平均始终 ≤ 算术平均，波动: Volatility drags compounding: a 20% gain followed by a 5% loss does not cancel out, so the geometric mean is always ≤ the arithmetic mean, and the larger the volatility, the wider the gap.
map.为什么几何平均总低于算术平均？: Why is the geometric mean always below the arithmetic mean?
map.这是「波动拖累」：先涨 10% 再跌 10%，净值回到 0.99，算术平均是 0: This is the volatility drag: up 10% then down 10% leaves net value at 0.99, so the arithmetic mean is 0% while you actually lost 1%. As long as returns fluctuate, the geometric mean is below the arithmetic mean, and the gap grows with volatility.
